record.field: # Don't call this server action if you don't want to loose all your work entries # Scoped to the current company/companies: this is a technical action meant to # be run against one company's data, not to silently wipe every company in the # database at once. env['hr.work.entry'].search([('company_id', 'in', env.companies.ids)]).unlink() now = datetime.datetime.now() env['hr.version'].search([('company_id', 'in', env.companies.ids)]).write({ 'date_generated_from': now, 'date_generated_to': now })
